statement: When a NIP-07 provider appears after initial page load, the login affordance updates from a disabled no-extension state to an enabled Nostr login state without a full reload.
When a signer becomes available after bootstrap, the stale missing-signer warning is removed.
Relay connection attempts surface an explicit connecting state before the socket opens or fails.
Saving relay settings reports a concrete connected/total relay summary instead of a generic success message.
Removing a configured relay does not strand pending relay work; pending publishes/queries resolve with a relay-removal outcome.
